notes: 8 equal segments, clockwise from 12 o'clock, transcribed from spinner/Spinner Front.svg. Cards use either the segment's action or its color dot, never both at once. The 'closest spot' segment shows all three colors; when a card asks for a color, that segment needs a rule (see open questions).

segments.text: GO TO THE NEBULA FOR 1 TURN
ROLL 2 DICE — GO FORWARD THAT AMOUNT
GO TO THE DRAGON AND FIGHT!
DUEL A PLAYER — WINNER GOES +5, LOSER GOES -1
MOVE TO THE CLOSEST RED, BLUE, OR GREEN SPOT
